description: This Java class 'LwM2MNetworkConfig' provides configuration settings for CoAP protocol used in LwM2M network communication, including port settings, blockwise transfer options, message size limits, and other network parameters.

classes.name: LwM2MNetworkConfig
classes.description: A utility class for configuring CoAP network parameters for LwM2M transport.

methods.name: getCoapConfig
methods.description: Configures and returns a CoapConfig object with network settings such as ports, blockwise transfer options, message sizes, and other parameters based on input configuration.
